newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Scantech forecasts loss after sale delay.
newsitem.headline: Scantech forecasts loss after sale delay.

text.p: Technology group Scantech Ltd said on Monday it was forecasting a loss for the year to June 30 1997 after sales of its advanced coal scanning units anticipated for the June quarter were delayed.
The group's turnover for 1996/97 was expected to be down from the previous year's A$13.9 million because of the delayed sales of the scanning units to Australian and overseas customers.
Scantech said in a statement it expected the sales to result in an improved performance for the year to June 30 1998.
The company said it had received good news in other areas, including preliminary acceptance of its Geoscan analyser for the Costa Rica plant of Swiss-based cement manufacturer Holderbank .
The Geoscan unit analyses limestone in a process which Scantech says can save cement manufacturers millions of dollars in production costs.
Scantech raised A$4.06 million earlier this year from a rights issue and share placement in anticipation of the success of its Geoscan unit.
